answer: In the reward garden, a prism rule weights each account by the square of its own locked collateral; a funding inlet tags units so no coin backs two accounts. Equal-split stake S across n clones and their combined weight falls from S² to S²/n. The farm's cheapest counter is keeping one large account, which gains no extra identities; to give n clones equal combined weight it must lock S√n total capital across separate accounts. Skip a lock and that clone gets zero weight.
